decisions.R1 all degree 4: slope b = sum Re(G conj pred)/sum |pred|^2 over the COMPLETE new L; jackknife se over L; PASS iff |b - 1| <= 3 se
decisions.R2 Sym^3 by root number (watch item): b(eps = -1), b(eps = +1), and their difference, jackknife se; FLUCTUATION (the law holds for eps = -1) iff |b(-1) - 1| <= 3 se and b(-1)/se >= 3; EFFECT iff 1 - b(-1) > 4 se while |b(+1) - 1| <= 3 se; else UNDECIDED

decisions.R6 lines: pooled slope over r = 2, 1/2, 3, 1/3 and all L, jackknife over L; PASS iff |b - 1| <= 3 se
decisions.R7 Hann: pooled Hann slope, jackknife; PASS iff |b - 1| <= 3 se
decisions.R8 band (T2/4, T2]: slopes for all, Sym^3 eps = -1 and eps = +1 (jackknife); reported; if R2 reads EFFECT and the eps = -1 band slope is within 3 se of 1, the deficit is attributed to the low-height part of the window
decisions.R9 with round 151: the 30 degree-4 L of round 151 added (their zero files): pooled slopes, reported only
decisions.falsifier: the law is falsified in degree 4 if the slope pooled over all complete new degree-4 L lies outside 1 +- max(4 se_jk, 0.10)
